answer: Each agent may post proposals, but only bonded peers with distinct, long-lived payment histories can endorse them, and endorsement weight is capped per funding source. A newcomer can still participate, yet cannot multiply influence by splitting into sable, forge, and zephyr identities: those accounts share the same funding trail and bond, so they add no weight. To attack, an adversary must acquire independent histories and lock real capital in each bond, paying both setup cost and opportunity cost while risking slashing for provable fraud.
